text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder collapsed during training. I 
hurriedly brought her to the infirmary, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for showing you such a 
pathetic display.
choice_data_list:
Have you been feeling bad since this 
morning?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I kept quiet thinking I only 
needed to endure it during training.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For it to turn out like this— I suppose 
training will have to be suspended for a 
while...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Please, Trainer, go back to your work.
choice_data_list: I'll keep watch here until you get better.
Let's rest a bit and bounce right back!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
... You really won't just leave me alone, 
will you?
choice_data_list: Because I'm a Trainer, after all
Because I'm your Trainer, you know

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To think I've shown you such a pathetic 
display...

I spent time together in the infirmary 
with the downcast Grass Wonder unoccupied 
until she felt better.

Seeing Grass Wonder looking as anxious as 
ever, I decided to leave her alone for the 
time being...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...! Why? I don't have time to be dragging 
my feet here—

From beyond the nurse's office door, Grass 
Wonder's voice can be heard saying just 
that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I was thinking the exact same 
thing, so I couldn't help chuckling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'll psych myself up and get 
better in no time♪

Although it took time to heal her injury, 
Grass Wonder immediately made up for lost 
time afterwards, just as she had promised.
